page.layout: One printed page, a title page printed upside down on the scan. Text block centred from top to bottom, with a rule-bordered panel; below the title, a short block of lines in two or three sizes, then a publisher's imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: Accedunt Duplicem Dissertationes II. de Pseudo-Dionysio Scriptore, & de Epistolis ad Aedificatos, authore Lucae.
Ioannis Haulbii, & Nicolai [?] Anecdota loci qui(?) Ioannis:
Impensis Ricardi Chiswell, Et Veneunt apud [?]

page.notes: The scan is rotated 180 degrees, so the whole title page reads upside down; I have transcribed it in reading order after rotation. The title page is largely faint and show-through from the other side is present. Most readings of the title lines and the imprint are uncertain and marked with [?] or illegible; the Greek and Latin of the title lines should be checked against the original. Library stamps and the digitiser's banner at the lower right are not transcribed.
